notes: Raw subprocess bytes are base64, including binary smoke controls and failed qualification attempts. File timestamps bound each command; time records and Minitest summaries supply measured elapsed times. All complete runs are retained; no further complete baseline is authorized by this handoff.

command: child = Process.spawn(RbConfig.ruby, "-e", "sleep 2", pgroup: true); checks = {}; {signal_host: -> { Process.kill(0, Process.pid) }, signal_group: -> { Process.kill(0, -child) }, getpgid_child: -> { Process.getpgid(child) }}.each { |name, check| begin; check.call; checks[name] = "PASS"; rescue SystemCallError => error; checks[name] = error.class.name; end }; puts JSON.generate(checks); Process.kill("TERM", child); Process.waitpid(child)
runs.name: liveness-probe

command: child = Process.spawn(RbConfig.ruby, "-e", "sleep 2", pgroup: true); begin; output, error, status = Open3.capture3("ps", "-o", "ppid=", "-o", "pgid=", "-p", child.to_s); puts JSON.generate(ps_exit: status.exitstatus, matches_parent_and_group: output.split.map(&:to_i) == [Process.pid, child], stderr_empty: error.empty?); rescue SystemCallError => error; puts JSON.generate(ps_exception: error.class.name); ensure; Process.kill("TERM", child); Process.waitpid(child); end
runs.name: ps-probe

command: load "Rakefile"; started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC); Rake::Task["actd:validate_yaml"].invoke; STDERR.puts JSON.generate(action_seconds: Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - started)
runs.name: yaml-action

targeted_child_hook_source:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Temporary targeted observer, never used for either complete baseline run.
require_relative "source/test/profile_suite"
SuiteProfile.install!
preload = "-r#{__FILE__}"
ENV["RUBYOPT"] = [ENV["RUBYOPT"], preload].compact.join(" ") unless ENV.fetch("RUBYOPT", "").include?(preload)
entrypoint = %w[prepare start launch checkpoint deliver status].include?(ARGV.first) ? ARGV.first : "other"
at_exit do
  directory = File.join(__dir__, "evidence", "child-followup")
  File.open(File.join(directory, "#{Process.pid}.json"), File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL, 0o600) do |file|
    file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(SuiteProfile.snapshot.merge(pid: Process.pid, parent_pid: Process.ppid, entrypoint: entrypoint)) + "\n")
  end
end
